lines.en: My joints click with every step.
Short leg bones, but plenty of steps.

lines.zh: 我边走边丢一块小骨头。
lines.en: I drop a small bone as I walk.
Two steps, and one tooth falls out.
I follow the hem of my master's robe.
Skeletons never pant while walking.
My footsteps sound like a wooden fish.
Do not step on me; I will fall apart.
One hop, three bone rattles.
Walk faster; my joke is not finished.
My shadow is as thin as a stick.
Bones catch the wind and whistle.
I told myself a joke.
Nobody laughed, so I laughed first.
I count my ribs and forget at five.
My jaw came loose; I click it back.
My master's axe is more famous than me.
I practice a mocking expression.
One bone is missing from this pile.
I hum, with bones as my only band.
Standing long makes my knees rattle.
I am waiting to be thrown.
Big one, your complexion is terrible.
I stare at you; that is politeness.

lines.zh: 你有肉，我没有，真不公平。
lines.en: You have flesh; I do not. So unfair.
Your knees look rather brittle.
I aim my eye sockets at you.
Do not blink; I am counting.
You look at me; I laugh at you.
I am looking for your funny bone.

lines.zh: 你把头转过来，我讲笑话。
lines.en: Turn your head; I have a joke.
Look at my teeth; are they even?
Ow, my poor ribs.
You knocked out a tooth.
Half of me is loose, but reparable.
No pain sense, but I am annoyed.
My head rolled off to one side.
That blow actually made me laugh.

lines.zh: 你敲裂了我最直的那根骨头。
lines.en: You cracked the straightest bone I own.
Not the face; I still have jokes.
I crouch to gather my own parts.
Just wait; I hold grudges.
Food? I do not have a stomach.
Will that bread trade for my tooth?
Luring me with meat? I cannot chew.
I cannot smell anything, thanks.

lines.zh: 食物放我嘴里会掉出来。
lines.en: Food would fall right through my jaw.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我够不着。
lines.en: Hold the bread high; I cannot reach.
I would rather be thrown ten times.
Bones taste better than bread, probably.
Do not feed me; feed my master.

lines.zh: 你的胡萝卜会从我下巴漏下去。
lines.en: Your carrot would fall straight through my jaw.
You knocked three ribs loose.
I am gathering bones; move aside.
Bumping me is the same as dismantling me.
We collide, and I come apart first.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩碎了我的脚趾骨。
lines.en: Your boot crushed the small bones of my toes.
I wobble, then piece myself back.
Do not crowd me; my joints are loose.

lines.zh: 这一撞，骨头响得真好听。
lines.en: That collision made a lovely bone sound.
You outweigh me, so I yield this round.
I back away before more teeth drop.

lines.zh: 谈恋爱？我连下巴都留不住。
lines.en: Romance? I cannot even keep my jaw.
Skeletons do not have such needs.

lines.zh: 找对象不如找根好骨头。
lines.en: A partner? I prefer a good bone.

lines.zh: 我的婚礼只有一顶旧头盔。
lines.en: My wedding would have one old helmet.
Do not matchmake; I will fall apart.

lines.zh: 我们骷髅只跟灰尘作伴。
lines.en: We skeletons keep company with dust.
Asking me that makes me awkward.
I have no heart, so no heart to give.
My master says no romance allowed.
Have children? First find some bones.
That bone is mine now.
I collect teeth, not trash.

lines.zh: 弯腰时我会掉一根肋骨。
lines.en: Bending costs me one rib.
That tooth you dropped is mine.
I hug the bone and run two steps.
This bone has a lovely shape.

lines.zh: 那根股骨是我先叼住的。
lines.en: I clamped that femur first; it is mine.
My pocket is full of bone chips.
The more I carry, the louder I walk.
This one is for my master to study.
My master pointed at you; I laughed.
You have been chosen as my toy.
I will toss a bone first to test.
Big one, come play with us.
I laugh so hard my teeth shake.
You must look funny when you run.
I follow right at your heels.
Target locked; the joke begins.

lines.zh: 主人要你，我要看你出丑。
lines.en: Master wants you; I want the show.
Do not hide; my throws are accurate.
This bone of mine aims for knees.
Your frown is hilarious.
Here, catch this one.
Run; I will chase and giggle.

lines.zh: 你这么高，骨头要扔得高一点。
lines.en: You are so tall; I must throw higher.
I raise my arm and aim at your head.
This bone is slightly bent.
You are not laughing, so I throw more.
The laughter arrives first, the bone after.
I count three, then throw.
Do not think skeletons cannot aim.
I switch to a harder bone.
You dodge left; I throw right.
Master is watching; I must be accurate.
This one carries my mockery.
The bone flies; I hop after it.
You guard your head; I hit your feet.
I laugh so hard my jaw drops off.
Last bone, saved for your forehead.

lines.zh: 我把骨头在手里颠了颠。
lines.en: I bounce the bone in my hand.

lines.zh: 我故意扔偏，看你会不会躲。
lines.en: I aim wide on purpose, to see if you dodge.
I laugh so hard my shoulders shake.
There is a wall behind you; I counted.
I rap your head with a bone.
That one did not hurt, did it?
You hit me; I laugh louder.
The bone broke; I grab another.
I kick your shin bone.
Your blood splatters on my teeth.
I sink my teeth into your trouser leg.
Hey, lend me one of your ribs.
I pat your shoulder, with a bone.
You back off; I keep swinging.
That knock gave me an echo.

lines.zh: 我的手臂只剩骨头，也够用。
lines.en: My arm is only bone, and enough.
I hit you; now let me laugh a while.
Do not be angry; it is only a joke.
I ram your knee with my skull.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的衣角，扯了一下。
lines.en: I grab your hem and give it a yank.

lines.zh: 我从主人的手里飞出来。
lines.en: I fly out of my master's hand.
My landing scattered half of my bones.
Bones rolled everywhere; I gather them.
I arrive covered in dust.
Who wants to hear a joke?
I reassemble myself and stand.
My master threw me far too high.
That landing made a splendid noise.
I giggle my way back to my feet.
New place, new audience.
Bones clink on the stone, ding.
Let me strike a scary pose first.
I seem to be missing two teeth.
The show begins; do not wander off.
My bones are charring black.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我碎成几块。
lines.en: Dropping from a height, I break into pieces.

lines.zh: 水把我冲得骨头都飘了。
lines.en: The water floats my bones apart.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹成一堆骨屑。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into bone dust.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我两根肋骨之间。
lines.en: The arrowhead lodges between two of my ribs.

lines.zh: 法术把我骨头都震麻了。
lines.en: The spell rattles every bone in me.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，可我还是饿。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet I still feel hungry.
The lightning turns my bones a stark white.

lines.zh: 虚空里我连骨头都看不见。
lines.en: In the void I cannot even see my bones.
